家族写真の撮影を計画していますか？家族全員が直面する一番の質問は「みんな何を着る？」です。答えは思ったよりシンプル — お揃いの服装です。コーディネートされた家族の服装は美しく写真に映り、視覚的なストーリーを伝え、服装選びのストレスを減らします。

プロのカメラマンを予約する場合も、ホリデーカード用の写真を撮る場合も、SNS用の素敵な家族写真が欲しい場合も、このガイドは季節やシチュエーションに合わせたお揃いの服装アイデアでサポートします。

注文前に一人ひとりの服装を計画する

写真に写る一人ひとりについて、着るアイテム、選ぶサイズ、必要な数量、手持ちで合わせられる服を一行ずつ書き出しましょう。好きな柄や色を一つ選び、それを基準に全体を組み合わせます。

  1. アイテムを選ぶ。 誰にドレス、シャツ、または別のアイテムが必要かを決めましょう。バッグに追加する前に、選択した商品に何が含まれるかを確認してください。
  2. 全員のサイズを確認する。 その商品のページにあるサイズ表を開きます。記載された寸法と単位を比較し、年齢表示は目安として使いましょう。スタイルによってサイズ展開が異なる場合があります。
  3. アイテムの数を数える。 別売りのドレスは、ママ用のサイズと娘用のサイズをそれぞれ別の選択として追加してください。バッグの各明細と合計金額を確認しましょう。
  4. お届け先への配送時期を確認する。 注文前に最新の配達予定と配送情報を読み、全員が試着できる時間を確保してください。撮影日が近い場合は、すでに持っている服を使いましょう。
  5. コーディネートを仕上げる。 服を靴や手持ちの重ね着用アイテムと一緒に並べます。全員が楽に座り、歩き、動けることを確認しましょう。

コーデの基準にできるママと娘のドレス二つのスタイル

  • ママと娘のお揃いVibrant Rainbowマキシドレス：虹色のストライプを基準に、その中の一色をほかの家族の服にも取り入れましょう。
  • ママと娘のお揃いPastel Bloomドレス：パステルカラーの花柄を中心に、すでに持っているアイテムと組み合わせましょう。

どちらのスタイルも、ママ用と娘用のドレスは一着ずつ別売りです。選べるサイズ、価格、サイズの選び方、配達予定は現在の商品ページで確認してください。ほかの選択肢は、こちらの ママと娘のお揃いドレスをご覧ください。

黄金律：クローンではなくコーディネートを

最高の家族写真はコーディネートされた服装が特徴です — 必ずしも全員が同じ服である必要はありません。みんなが一緒にいるように見えつつ、制服のように見えないのが理想です。方法はこちら：

  • カラーパレットを選ぶ — 互いに補完し合う2〜3色を選びましょう
  • 柄と無地を組み合わせる — ママが柄のドレスなら、パパは同じ色の無地シャツを着ると良いです
  • フォーマルさのレベルを揃える — ボールガウンとジーンズを混ぜないように
  • 一人を基準にする — 一番好きな服装を選び、他の人はそれに合わせてコーディネートしましょう

家族写真に最適なカラーパレット

クラシックニュートラル

クリーム、ベージュ、タン、ホワイト — 時代を超えたエレガントさ。ビーチ、スタジオ、野原のどこでも美しく映えます。ニット、リネン、レースで質感を加えて平坦に見えないようにしましょう。このパレットは決して色あせません。

青と白

新鮮で清潔感があり、誰にでも似合う。ネイビー、シャンブレー、ライトブルー、ホワイトの組み合わせはいつも写真映えします。おそらく最も人気のある家族写真のカラースキームです。青系の選択肢はトップスコレクションをご覧ください。

アーストーン

ラスト、オリーブ、マスタード、バーガンディ、クリーム — 秋の家族写真にぴったり。これらの暖かい色はゴールデンアワーの光に映え、紅葉やパンプキンパッチなど秋の背景とよく合います。

ジュエルトーン

エメラルド、サファイア、ルビー、ゴールド — 豊かで豪華。これらの色は屋内外のどちらの環境でも映え、ホリデー写真に最適です。フォーマルすぎずにおしゃれに決まります。

パステルカラー

柔らかいピンク、ラベンダー、ミント、ベビーブルー — 夢のようにフェミニン。春の写真やイースターの撮影、ママと娘のお揃いドレスを楽しむ場面にぴったり。淡い色は柔らかな自然光の下で最も美しく写ります。

季節ごとの家族写真の服装

春の写真

軽やかなレイヤー、花柄プリント、パステルカラーが春の家族写真の特徴です。例えば：

  • ママと娘はお揃いの花柄ドレスで
  • パパと息子はチノパンに合わせたボタンダウンシャツでコーディネート
  • 家族全員が柔らかいパステルカラーで
  • 重ね着用の軽いカーディガンやジャケット

夏の写真

軽やかで通気性の良い服装を心がけましょう。白と青のパレットは爽やかでビーチ感があります。次の点を考慮してください：

  • ビーチ写真にぴったりのお揃いの水着
  • 風になびくリネンやコットンの服
  • ママと娘はサンドレス、パパと息子はカジュアルシャツ
  • ビーチで裸足 — 最も自然な夏のスタイル

秋の写真

家族写真で最も人気のある季節。深みのある色と暖かみのある質感が映えます：

  • お揃いのセーターやコーディネートされたニット
  • チェック柄やフランネルのアクセント
  • ブーツ、マフラー、レイヤードスタイル
  • 秋の背景に映えるアーストーンのカラーパレット

冬・ホリデー写真

ホリデー写真はお揃いコーデの絶好のチャンス：

  • ツリーの前でのお揃いクリスマスパジャマ
  • ホリデーカード用のフォーマルなコーディネート
  • お揃いのホリデーセーター
  • 赤、緑、ゴールド、または冬のホワイトのカラースキーム

家族写真で避けるべきこと

写真映えしにくいものいくつか：

  • 大きなロゴや文字 — 顔から注意がそれます
  • ネオンカラー — 肌に不自然な反射を与えることがあります
  • 全身黒 — 細部が見えにくく重たい印象に
  • 柄がバラバラでごちゃごちゃ — みんな違う柄だと視覚的に混乱します
  • 新品の靴 — 硬い靴で歩きにくい子どもは自然な写真が撮れません
  • 不快な服装 — 誰かが服を引っ張っていると写真に表れます

家族写真のプロからのアドバイス

  1. 配達予定に合わせて計画する — お届け先への配達予定を確認し、撮影前に服を試着できる時間を確保しましょう
  2. 全ての服を一緒に並べる — 撮影前にグループとしての見た目を確認
  3. 予備の服を持参 — 特に小さなお子さん用に（汚れはつきものです）
  4. アイロンやスチームをかける — シワは写真に映ります
  5. アクセサリーをプラス — 帽子、リボン、そしてヘッドバンドで個性を演出
  6. 快適さ第一 — 笑顔で快適に過ごす家族は、完璧な服装でも居心地の悪い家族より写真映えします

すぐに使える家族お揃いコーデ

全部自分でコーディネートしたくない？それこそが家族お揃い服の目的です。私たちのコレクションは、家族の服選びの悩みを解消するために作られています：

  • ママとお揃いコーデ — ワンピース、トップス、セットアップ
  • パパとお揃いコーデ — お揃いのTシャツとショーツ
  • 家族お揃いセット — 全員がまとまったコーディネート
  • 家族全員お揃いコーデ — みんなが揃ってストレスなし

Planning a family photo session? The number one question every family faces is: what do we all wear? The answer is simpler than you think — matching outfits. Coordinated family looks photograph beautifully, tell a visual story, and take the stress out of outfit planning.

Whether you’re booking a professional photographer, taking holiday card photos, or just want great family pictures for social media, this guide has you covered with matching outfit ideas for every season and setting.

Plan each person's outfit before you order

Make one line for each person in your photo: the piece they will wear, their selected size, the quantity you need, and anything they already own that coordinates. Start with one print or color you love, then build around it.

  1. Choose the pieces. Decide who needs a dress, a shirt, or another item. Check what each product selection includes before adding it to your bag.
  2. Check every person's size. Open the size chart on that exact product page. Compare the measurements and units shown; use age labels as a starting point. Different styles can use different size ranges.
  3. Count the items. For dresses sold separately, add a mother size and a daughter size as separate selections. Review each line and the combined price in your bag.
  4. Check timing for your destination. Read the current delivery estimate and shipping information before ordering, and allow time to try everything on. If your photo date is close, use an outfit you already have.
  5. Finish the look. Lay the outfits together with shoes and any layers you own. Check that everyone can sit, walk, and move comfortably.

Two mother-daughter dress looks to build around

  • Vibrant Rainbow Mommy and Me Maxi Dresses: start with the rainbow stripes, then use one of those colors for other family members' clothes.
  • Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses: build around the pastel floral print and coordinate with pieces you already own.

For both looks, each mother or daughter dress is sold separately. Check the current product page for selectable sizes, prices, size guidance, and delivery estimates. For more options, browse mommy and me dresses.

The Golden Rule: Coordinate, Don’t Clone

The best family photos feature coordinated outfits — not necessarily identical ones. You want everyone to look like they belong together without looking like a uniform. Here’s how:

  • Pick a color palette — choose 2-3 colors that complement each other
  • Mix patterns and solids — if mom wears a patterned dress, dad can wear a solid shirt in a matching color
  • Keep the same level of formality — don’t mix ball gowns with jeans
  • Let one person be the anchor — pick the outfit you love most, then coordinate everyone else around it

Best Color Palettes for Family Photos

Classic Neutrals

Cream, beige, tan, and white — timeless and elegant. Works beautifully on the beach, in a studio, or in a field. Add texture with knits, linen, or lace to keep it from looking flat. This palette never goes out of style.

Blue and White

Fresh, clean, and universally flattering. Navy, chambray, light blue, and white in various combinations always photograph well. This is probably the most popular family photo color scheme for a reason. Browse our tops collection for blue options.

Earth Tones

Rust, olive, mustard, burgundy, and cream — perfect for fall family photos. These warm colors look incredible in golden hour light and complement autumn backdrops like changing leaves and pumpkin patches.

Jewel Tones

Emerald, sapphire, ruby, and gold — rich and luxurious. These colors pop against both indoor and outdoor settings and look stunning in holiday photos. Perfect for dressing up without going too formal.

Pastels

Soft pink, lavender, mint, and baby blue — dreamy and feminine. Beautiful for spring photos, Easter sessions, and mommy and me dress moments. Light colors photograph best in soft, natural light.

Family Photo Outfits by Season

Spring Photos

Light layers, floral prints, and pastel colors define spring family photos. Think:

  • Mom and daughter in matching floral dresses
  • Dad and son in coordinating button-downs with chinos
  • The whole family in soft pastels
  • Light cardigans or jackets for layering

Summer Photos

Keep it light and breathable. White and blue palettes look fresh and beachy. Consider:

  • Matching swimsuits for beach photos
  • Linen or cotton outfits that flow in the breeze
  • Sundresses for mom and daughter, casual shirts for dad and son
  • Bare feet on the beach — the most natural summer look

Fall Photos

The most popular season for family photos. Rich colors and cozy textures shine:

  • Matching sweaters or coordinating knits
  • Plaid and flannel accents
  • Boots, scarves, and layered looks
  • Earth tone color palettes against autumn backdrops

Winter / Holiday Photos

Holiday photos are the ultimate matching opportunity:

  • Matching Christmas pajamas in front of the tree
  • Coordinating dressy outfits for holiday cards
  • Matching holiday sweaters
  • Red, green, gold, or winter white color schemes

What to Avoid in Family Photos

A few things that don’t photograph well:

  • Large logos or text — distracts from faces
  • Neon colors — can cast unflattering reflections on skin
  • All black — loses detail and can look heavy
  • Busy patterns that clash — if everyone wears a different pattern, it’s visual chaos
  • Brand new shoes — kids walking weird in stiff new shoes kills candid shots
  • Anything uncomfortable — if someone is pulling at their clothes, it shows in photos

Pro Tips from Family Photographers

  1. Plan around your delivery estimate — check the estimate for your destination and allow time to try on outfits before the photo session
  2. Lay all outfits out together — see how they look as a group before the shoot
  3. Bring a backup outfit — especially for little ones (spills happen)
  4. Iron or steam everything — wrinkles show up in photos
  5. Accessorize — hats, bows, and headbands add personality
  6. Comfort first — a happy, comfortable family always photographs better than an uncomfortable one in perfect outfits

Ready-Made Matching Family Outfits

Don’t want to coordinate everything yourself? That’s exactly what matching family outfits are for. Our collections are designed to take the guesswork out of family dressing:

  • Mommy and Me matching outfits — dresses, tops, and sets
  • Daddy and Me outfits — coordinating tees and shorts
  • Family matching sets — coordinated looks for the whole crew
  • Full family matching — everyone matches, no stress

The best family photos capture who you are — together. And matching outfits are the easiest way to make sure everyone looks and feels like a team. Start browsing, pick your palette, and get ready to create some memories.

가족 사진 촬영을 계획 중이신가요? 모든 가족이 가장 많이 하는 질문은: 우리 모두 뭘 입을까? 답은 생각보다 간단합니다 — 코디된 옷차림. 코디된 가족 모습은 사진이 아름답고, 시각적인 이야기를 전하며, 옷차림 계획의 스트레스를 줄여줍니다.

전문 사진작가를 예약하든, 휴일 카드 사진을 찍든, 소셜 미디어용 멋진 가족 사진을 원하든, 이 가이드는 모든 계절과 상황에 맞는 코디 아이디어를 제공합니다.

황금률: 복제하지 말고 조화롭게 코디하세요

최고의 가족 사진은 코디된 옷차림을 보여줍니다 — 꼭 똑같을 필요는 없습니다. 모두가 함께 어울리면서도 유니폼 같지 않게 보이도록 하는 것이 중요합니다. 방법은 다음과 같습니다:

  • 색상 팔레트를 고르세요 — 서로 어울리는 2-3가지 색상을 선택하세요
  • 패턴과 단색을 섞으세요 — 엄마가 패턴 드레스를 입으면 아빠는 같은 색상의 단색 셔츠를 입을 수 있습니다
  • 같은 격식을 유지하세요 — 드레스와 청바지를 섞지 마세요
  • 한 사람을 중심으로 정하세요 — 가장 좋아하는 옷을 고르고 나머지는 그에 맞춰 코디하세요

가족 사진에 가장 좋은 색상 팔레트

클래식 뉴트럴

크림, 베이지, 탄, 흰색 — 시대를 초월한 우아함. 해변, 스튜디오, 들판 어디서나 아름답게 어울립니다. 니트, 린넨, 레이스로 질감을 더해 평면적으로 보이지 않게 하세요. 이 팔레트는 절대 유행을 타지 않습니다.

파랑과 흰색

신선하고 깔끔하며 누구에게나 잘 어울립니다. 네이비, 샴브레이, 연한 파랑, 흰색을 다양한 조합으로 입으면 항상 사진이 잘 나옵니다. 아마도 가장 인기 있는 가족 사진 색상 조합일 것입니다. 파란색 옵션은 상의 컬렉션을 둘러보세요.

어스 톤

러스트, 올리브, 머스타드, 버건디, 크림 — 가을 가족 사진에 완벽한 색상. 이 따뜻한 색상들은 황금 시간대 빛에서 놀랍게 보이며, 변하는 나뭇잎과 호박밭 같은 가을 배경과 잘 어울립니다.

보석 톤

에메랄드, 사파이어, 루비, 골드 — 풍부하고 고급스러운 색상. 실내외 어디서나 돋보이며 휴일 사진에 멋지게 어울립니다. 너무 격식 차리지 않고도 차려입기에 완벽합니다.

파스텔

부드러운 분홍, 라벤더, 민트, 베이비 블루 — 꿈결 같고 여성스러운 색상. 봄 사진, 부활절 촬영, 그리고 엄마와 나 드레스 순간에 아름답습니다. 밝은 색상은 부드럽고 자연스러운 빛에서 가장 잘 촬영됩니다.

계절별 가족 사진 의상

봄 사진

가벼운 레이어, 플로럴 프린트, 파스텔 색상이 봄 가족 사진을 정의합니다. 생각해 보세요:

  • 엄마와 딸이 플로럴 드레스를 맞춰 입은 모습
  • 아빠와 아들이 코디된 버튼다운 셔츠와 치노 팬츠를 입은 모습
  • 온 가족이 부드러운 파스텔 색상으로
  • 레이어링용 가벼운 가디건이나 재킷

여름 사진

가볍고 통기성 좋게 입으세요. 흰색과 파란색 팔레트는 신선하고 해변 느낌을 줍니다. 다음을 고려해 보세요:

  • 해변 사진을 위한 맞춘 수영복
  • 바람에 흩날리는 린넨 또는 면 소재 의상
  • 엄마와 딸을 위한 썬드레스, 아빠와 아들을 위한 캐주얼 셔츠
  • 해변에서 맨발 — 가장 자연스러운 여름 룩

가을 사진

가족 사진에 가장 인기 있는 계절. 풍부한 색감과 포근한 질감이 돋보입니다:

  • 맞춘 스웨터 또는 조화로운 니트
  • 플래드와 플란넬 포인트
  • 부츠, 스카프, 레이어드 룩
  • 가을 배경에 어울리는 어스톤 색상 팔레트

겨울 / 홀리데이 사진

홀리데이 사진은 최고의 맞춤 기회입니다:

  • 트리 앞에서 입는 맞춘 크리스마스 파자마
  • 홀리데이 카드용으로 맞춘 격식 있는 옷
  • 맞춘 홀리데이 스웨터
  • 빨강, 초록, 금색, 겨울 흰색 색상 조합

가족 사진에서 피해야 할 것들

사진에 잘 나오지 않는 몇 가지

  • 큰 로고나 글자 — 얼굴에서 시선을 분산시킵니다
  • 네온 색상 — 피부에 불리한 반사가 생길 수 있습니다
  • 올블랙 — 디테일이 사라지고 무거워 보일 수 있습니다
  • 서로 충돌하는 복잡한 패턴 — 모두 다른 패턴을 입으면 시각적으로 혼란스러워 보입니다
  • 새 신발 — 딱딱한 새 신발을 신은 아이들이 이상하게 걷는 모습은 자연스러운 사진을 망칩니다
  • 불편한 옷 — 누군가 옷을 만지작거리면 사진에 그대로 드러납니다

가족 사진작가의 전문가 팁

  1. 2주 전에 옷 계획하기 — 촬영 전날 급하게 준비하지 마세요
  2. 모든 옷을 함께 펼쳐보기 — 촬영 전에 전체적인 모습을 확인하세요
  3. 여분의 옷 준비 — 특히 아이들을 위해 (음료나 음식이 쏟아질 수 있으니까요)
  4. 모든 옷은 다림질 또는 스팀 처리 — 주름은 사진에 잘 드러납니다
  5. 액세서리 활용 — 모자, 리본, 그리고 헤어밴드로 개성을 더하세요
  6. 편안함 우선 — 편안한 가족이 완벽한 옷을 입은 불편한 가족보다 사진이 항상 더 잘 나옵니다

준비된 맞춤 가족 의상

모든 걸 직접 맞추기 귀찮으신가요? 맞춤 가족 의상이 바로 그런 분들을 위한 것입니다. 저희 컬렉션은 가족 옷 입히기의 고민을 덜어드리도록 디자인되었습니다:

  • 엄마와 나 맞춤 의상 — 원피스, 상의, 세트
  • 아빠와 나 의상 — 맞춘 티셔츠와 반바지
  • 가족 맞춤 세트 — 온 가족을 위한 조화로운 스타일
  • 가족 전체 맞춤복 — 모두가 맞춰 입고, 스트레스 없이

가장 멋진 가족 사진은 여러분이 함께하는 모습을 담아냅니다. 그리고 맞춰 입는 옷이 모두가 팀처럼 보이고 느끼게 하는 가장 쉬운 방법입니다. 지금 둘러보고, 색상을 고르고, 추억을 만들 준비를 해보세요.

가족 사진 촬영을 계획 중이신가요? 모든 가족이 가장 많이 하는 질문은: 우리 모두 뭘 입을까? 답은 생각보다 간단합니다 — 코디된 옷차림. 코디된 가족 모습은 사진이 아름답고, 시각적인 이야기를 전하며, 옷차림 계획의 스트레스를 줄여줍니다.

전문 사진작가를 예약하든, 휴일 카드 사진을 찍든, 소셜 미디어용 멋진 가족 사진을 원하든, 이 가이드는 모든 계절과 상황에 맞는 코디 아이디어를 제공합니다.

주문하기 전에 각자의 의상을 계획하세요

사진에 나올 사람마다 한 줄씩 적어 보세요. 입을 옷, 선택한 사이즈, 필요한 수량, 이미 가지고 있는 옷 중 어울리는 것을 적습니다. 마음에 드는 프린트나 색상 하나를 정하고 이를 중심으로 코디하세요.

  1. 옷을 선택하세요. 누구에게 드레스, 셔츠 또는 다른 옷이 필요한지 정하세요. 장바구니에 담기 전에 선택한 상품에 무엇이 포함되는지 확인하세요.
  2. 각자의 사이즈를 확인하세요. 바로 그 상품 페이지의 사이즈표를 여세요. 표시된 치수와 단위를 비교하고, 연령 표시는 출발점으로 참고하세요. 스타일마다 사이즈 범위가 다를 수 있습니다.
  3. 상품 수량을 세어 보세요. 별도로 판매되는 드레스는 엄마 사이즈와 딸 사이즈를 각각 따로 선택해 담으세요. 장바구니의 각 항목과 합계 금액을 확인하세요.
  4. 배송지에 따른 일정을 확인하세요. 주문 전에 현재 배송 예상일과 배송 정보를 읽고, 모든 옷을 입어 볼 시간을 확보하세요. 촬영 날짜가 가깝다면 이미 가지고 있는 옷을 활용하세요.
  5. 스타일을 완성하세요. 의상을 신발과 이미 가지고 있는 겉옷 등과 함께 펼쳐 보세요. 모두 편안하게 앉고 걷고 움직일 수 있는지 확인하세요.

코디의 기준으로 삼을 엄마와 딸의 드레스 스타일 두 가지

  • 엄마와 딸의 Vibrant Rainbow 시밀러룩 맥시드레스: 무지개 줄무늬를 기준으로 그중 한 가지 색상을 다른 가족의 옷에도 활용하세요.
  • 엄마와 딸의 Pastel Bloom 시밀러룩 드레스: 파스텔 꽃무늬를 중심으로 이미 가지고 있는 옷과 조화롭게 코디하세요.

두 스타일 모두 엄마용 또는 딸용 드레스가 각각 별도로 판매됩니다. 선택 가능한 사이즈, 가격, 사이즈 안내, 배송 예상일은 현재 상품 페이지에서 확인하세요. 더 많은 선택지는 엄마와 딸의 시밀러룩 드레스에서 살펴보세요.

황금률: 복제하지 말고 조화롭게 코디하세요

최고의 가족 사진은 코디된 옷차림을 보여줍니다 — 꼭 똑같을 필요는 없습니다. 모두가 함께 어울리면서도 유니폼 같지 않게 보이도록 하는 것이 중요합니다. 방법은 다음과 같습니다:

  • 색상 팔레트를 고르세요 — 서로 어울리는 2-3가지 색상을 선택하세요
  • 패턴과 단색을 섞으세요 — 엄마가 패턴 드레스를 입으면 아빠는 같은 색상의 단색 셔츠를 입을 수 있습니다
  • 같은 격식을 유지하세요 — 무도회용 드레스와 청바지를 섞지 마세요
  • 한 사람을 중심으로 정하세요 — 가장 좋아하는 옷을 고르고 나머지는 그에 맞춰 코디하세요

가장 멋진 가족 사진은 여러분이 함께하는 모습을 담아냅니다. 그리고 맞춰 입는 옷이 모두가 팀처럼 보이고 느끼게 하는 가장 쉬운 방법입니다. 지금 둘러보고, 색상을 고르고, 추억을 만들 준비를 해보세요.

Planning a family photo session? The number one question every family faces is: what do we all wear? The answer is simpler than you think — matching outfits. Coordinated family looks photograph beautifully, tell a visual story, and take the stress out of outfit planning.

Whether you’re booking a professional photographer, taking holiday card photos, or just want great family pictures for social media, this guide has you covered with matching outfit ideas for every season and setting.

Plan each person's outfit before you order

Make one line for each person in your photo: the piece they will wear, their selected size, the quantity you need, and anything they already own that coordinates. Start with one print or color you love, then build around it.

  1. Choose the pieces. Decide who needs a dress, a shirt, or another item. Check what each product selection includes before adding it to your bag.
  2. Check every person's size. Open the size chart on that exact product page. Compare the measurements and units shown; use age labels as a starting point. Different styles can use different size ranges.
  3. Count the items. For dresses sold separately, add a mother size and a daughter size as separate selections. Review each line and the combined price in your bag.
  4. Check timing for your destination. Read the current delivery estimate and shipping information before ordering, and allow time to try everything on. If your photo date is close, use an outfit you already have.
  5. Finish the look. Lay the outfits together with shoes and any layers you own. Check that everyone can sit, walk, and move comfortably.

Two mother-daughter dress looks to build around

  • Vibrant Rainbow Mommy and Me Maxi Dresses: start with the rainbow stripes, then use one of those colors for other family members' clothes.
  • Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses: build around the pastel floral print and coordinate with pieces you already own.

For both looks, each mother or daughter dress is sold separately. Check the current product page for selectable sizes, prices, size guidance, and delivery estimates. For more options, browse mommy and me dresses.

The Golden Rule: Coordinate, Don’t Clone

The best family photos feature coordinated outfits — not necessarily identical ones. You want everyone to look like they belong together without looking like a uniform. Here’s how:

  • Pick a color palette — choose 2-3 colors that complement each other
  • Mix patterns and solids — if mom wears a patterned dress, dad can wear a solid shirt in a matching color
  • Keep the same level of formality — don’t mix ball gowns with jeans
  • Let one person be the anchor — pick the outfit you love most, then coordinate everyone else around it

Best Color Palettes for Family Photos

Classic Neutrals

Cream, beige, tan, and white — timeless and elegant. Works beautifully on the beach, in a studio, or in a field. Add texture with knits, linen, or lace to keep it from looking flat. This palette never goes out of style.

Blue and White

Fresh, clean, and universally flattering. Navy, chambray, light blue, and white in various combinations always photograph well. This is probably the most popular family photo color scheme for a reason. Browse our tops collection for blue options.

Earth Tones

Rust, olive, mustard, burgundy, and cream — perfect for fall family photos. These warm colors look incredible in golden hour light and complement autumn backdrops like changing leaves and pumpkin patches.

Jewel Tones

Emerald, sapphire, ruby, and gold — rich and luxurious. These colors pop against both indoor and outdoor settings and look stunning in holiday photos. Perfect for dressing up without going too formal.

Pastels

Soft pink, lavender, mint, and baby blue — dreamy and feminine. Beautiful for spring photos, Easter sessions, and mommy and me dress moments. Light colors photograph best in soft, natural light.

Family Photo Outfits by Season

Spring Photos

Light layers, floral prints, and pastel colors define spring family photos. Think:

  • Mom and daughter in matching floral dresses
  • Dad and son in coordinating button-downs with chinos
  • The whole family in soft pastels
  • Light cardigans or jackets for layering

Summer Photos

Keep it light and breathable. White and blue palettes look fresh and beachy. Consider:

  • Matching swimsuits for beach photos
  • Linen or cotton outfits that flow in the breeze
  • Sundresses for mom and daughter, casual shirts for dad and son
  • Bare feet on the beach — the most natural summer look

Fall Photos

The most popular season for family photos. Rich colors and cozy textures shine:

  • Matching sweaters or coordinating knits
  • Plaid and flannel accents
  • Boots, scarves, and layered looks
  • Earth tone color palettes against autumn backdrops

Winter / Holiday Photos

Holiday photos are the ultimate matching opportunity:

  • Matching Christmas pajamas in front of the tree
  • Coordinating dressy outfits for holiday cards
  • Matching holiday sweaters
  • Red, green, gold, or winter white color schemes

What to Avoid in Family Photos

A few things that don’t photograph well:

  • Large logos or text — distracts from faces
  • Neon colors — can cast unflattering reflections on skin
  • All black — loses detail and can look heavy
  • Busy patterns that clash — if everyone wears a different pattern, it’s visual chaos
  • Brand new shoes — kids walking weird in stiff new shoes kills candid shots
  • Anything uncomfortable — if someone is pulling at their clothes, it shows in photos

Pro Tips from Family Photographers

  1. Plan around your delivery estimate — check the estimate for your destination and allow time to try on outfits before the photo session
  2. Lay all outfits out together — see how they look as a group before the shoot
  3. Bring a backup outfit — especially for little ones (spills happen)
  4. Iron or steam everything — wrinkles show up in photos
  5. Accessorize — hats, bows, and headbands add personality
  6. Comfort first — a happy, comfortable family always photographs better than an uncomfortable one in perfect outfits

Ready-Made Matching Family Outfits

Don’t want to coordinate everything yourself? That’s exactly what matching family outfits are for. Our collections are designed to take the guesswork out of family dressing:

  • Mommy and Me matching outfits — dresses, tops, and sets
  • Daddy and Me outfits — coordinating tees and shorts
  • Family matching sets — coordinated looks for the whole crew
  • Full family matching — everyone matches, no stress

The best family photos capture who you are — together. And matching outfits are the easiest way to make sure everyone looks and feels like a team. Start browsing, pick your palette, and get ready to create some memories.

Plan je een gezinsfotosessie? De belangrijkste vraag voor elk gezin is: wat trekken we allemaal aan? Het antwoord is eenvoudiger dan je denkt — bijpassende outfits. Gecoördineerde gezinslooks fotograferen prachtig, vertellen een visueel verhaal en nemen de stress van het plannen van outfits weg.

Of je nu een professionele fotograaf boekt, vakantiefoto's maakt of gewoon mooie gezinsfoto's voor sociale media wilt, deze gids helpt je met bijpassende outfitideeën voor elk seizoen en elke setting.

De gouden regel: coördineer, kloon niet

De beste gezinsfoto's hebben gecoördineerde outfits — niet per se identieke. Je wilt dat iedereen eruitziet alsof ze bij elkaar horen zonder als een uniform te lijken. Zo doe je dat:

  • Kies een kleurenpalet — kies 2-3 kleuren die elkaar aanvullen
  • Mix patronen en effen kleuren — als mama een jurk met patroon draagt, kan papa een effen overhemd in een bijpassende kleur dragen
  • Houd hetzelfde niveau van formaliteit aan — mix geen baljurken met jeans
  • Laat één persoon het anker zijn — kies de outfit die je het mooist vindt en stem de rest daarop af

Beste kleurenpaletten voor gezinsfoto's

Klassieke neutrale kleuren

Crème, beige, tan en wit — tijdloos en elegant. Werkt prachtig op het strand, in een studio of in een veld. Voeg textuur toe met breisels, linnen of kant om te voorkomen dat het vlak oogt. Dit palet raakt nooit uit de mode.

Blauw en wit

Fris, schoon en universeel flatterend. Marineblauw, chambray, lichtblauw en wit in verschillende combinaties fotograferen altijd goed. Dit is waarschijnlijk het populairste kleurenpalet voor gezinsfoto's, en dat is niet voor niets. Bekijk onze topcollectie voor blauwe opties.

Aardetinten

Roest, olijf, mosterd, bordeaux en crème — perfect voor herfstfoto's van het gezin. Deze warme kleuren zien er geweldig uit in het gouden uurtje en passen bij herfstachtergronden zoals vallende bladeren en pompoenvelden.

Juweeltinten

Smaragd, saffier, robijn en goud — rijk en luxueus. Deze kleuren springen eruit in zowel binnen- als buitenomgevingen en zien er prachtig uit op vakantiefoto's. Perfect om je netjes te kleden zonder te formeel te zijn.

Pasteltinten

Zachtroze, lavendel, munt en babyblauw — dromerig en vrouwelijk. Prachtig voor lentefoto's, paasfoto's en mommy and me-jurken. Lichte kleuren fotograferen het beste in zacht, natuurlijk licht.

Gezinsfoto-outfits per seizoen

Lentefoto's

Lichte lagen, bloemenprints en pasteltinten bepalen lentefoto's van het gezin. Denk aan:

  • Moeder en dochter in bijpassende bloemenjurken
  • Vader en zoon in bijpassende overhemden met chinos
  • Het hele gezin in zachte pasteltinten
  • Lichte vesten of jassen om te laagjes te maken

Zomerfoto's

Houd het licht en ademend. Witte en blauwe kleurenpaletten zien er fris en strandachtig uit. Overweeg:

  • Bijpassende badpakken voor strandfoto’s
  • Linnen of katoenen outfits die meebewegen in de wind
  • Zomerjurkjes voor mama en dochter, casual overhemden voor papa en zoon
  • Blote voeten op het strand — de meest natuurlijke zomerse look

Herfstfoto’s

Het populairste seizoen voor familiefoto’s. Rijke kleuren en gezellige texturen stralen:

  • Bijpassende truien of gecoördineerde breisels
  • Ruiten en flanellen accenten
  • Laarzen, sjaals en gelaagde looks
  • Aardetinten paletten tegen herfstachtergronden

Winter / feestdagenfoto’s

Feestdagenfoto’s zijn de ultieme kans om te matchen:

  • Bijpassende kerstpyjama’s voor de kerstboom
  • Gecoördineerde nette outfits voor kerstkaarten
  • Bijpassende feestdagen truien
  • Rode, groene, gouden of winterwitte kleurenschema’s

Wat te vermijden in familiefoto’s

Een paar dingen die niet goed fotograferen:

  • Grote logo’s of tekst — leidt af van de gezichten
  • Neonkleuren — kunnen onaantrekkelijke reflecties op de huid geven
  • Helemaal zwart — verliest details en kan zwaar ogen
  • Drukke patronen die botsen — als iedereen een ander patroon draagt, is het visuele chaos
  • Gloednieuwe schoenen — kinderen die raar lopen op stijve nieuwe schoenen verpesten spontane foto’s
  • Alles wat ongemakkelijk is — als iemand aan zijn kleding trekt, is dat zichtbaar op foto’s

Pro tips van familie fotografen

  1. Plan outfits 2 weken van tevoren — niet last-minute regelen
  2. Leg alle outfits samen klaar — kijk hoe ze eruitzien als groep vóór de fotoshoot
  3. Neem een reserve-outfit mee — vooral voor kleintjes (vlekken gebeuren)
  4. Strijk of stoom alles — kreukels zijn zichtbaar op foto’s
  5. Accessoires — hoeden, strikken en haarbanden geven persoonlijkheid
  6. Comfort eerst — een gelukkige, comfortabele familie fotografeert altijd beter dan een ongemakkelijke in perfecte outfits

Kant-en-klare bijpassende familieoutfits

Wil je niet alles zelf coördineren? Daar zijn bijpassende familieoutfits precies voor. Onze collecties zijn ontworpen om het raden bij het aankleden van de familie weg te nemen:

  • Mama en ik matching outfits — jurken, tops en sets
  • Papa en ik outfits — bijpassende shirts en shorts
  • Familie matching sets — gecoördineerde looks voor de hele groep
  • Volledige familie-matching — iedereen matcht, geen stress

De beste familiefoto's leggen vast wie jullie zijn — samen. En bijpassende outfits zijn de makkelijkste manier om ervoor te zorgen dat iedereen eruitziet en zich voelt als een team. Begin met bladeren, kies je kleurenpalet en maak je klaar om herinneringen te creëren.

Planning a family photo session? The number one question every family faces is: what do we all wear? The answer is simpler than you think — matching outfits. Coordinated family looks photograph beautifully, tell a visual story, and take the stress out of outfit planning.

Whether you’re booking a professional photographer, taking holiday card photos, or just want great family pictures for social media, this guide has you covered with matching outfit ideas for every season and setting.

Plan each person's outfit before you order

Make one line for each person in your photo: the piece they will wear, their selected size, the quantity you need, and anything they already own that coordinates. Start with one print or color you love, then build around it.

  1. Choose the pieces. Decide who needs a dress, a shirt, or another item. Check what each product selection includes before adding it to your bag.
  2. Check every person's size. Open the size chart on that exact product page. Compare the measurements and units shown; use age labels as a starting point. Different styles can use different size ranges.
  3. Count the items. For dresses sold separately, add a mother size and a daughter size as separate selections. Review each line and the combined price in your bag.
  4. Check timing for your destination. Read the current delivery estimate and shipping information before ordering, and allow time to try everything on. If your photo date is close, use an outfit you already have.
  5. Finish the look. Lay the outfits together with shoes and any layers you own. Check that everyone can sit, walk, and move comfortably.

Two mother-daughter dress looks to build around

  • Vibrant Rainbow Mommy and Me Maxi Dresses: start with the rainbow stripes, then use one of those colors for other family members' clothes.
  • Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses: build around the pastel floral print and coordinate with pieces you already own.

For both looks, each mother or daughter dress is sold separately. Check the current product page for selectable sizes, prices, size guidance, and delivery estimates. For more options, browse mommy and me dresses.

The Golden Rule: Coordinate, Don’t Clone

The best family photos feature coordinated outfits — not necessarily identical ones. You want everyone to look like they belong together without looking like a uniform. Here’s how:

  • Pick a color palette — choose 2-3 colors that complement each other
  • Mix patterns and solids — if mom wears a patterned dress, dad can wear a solid shirt in a matching color
  • Keep the same level of formality — don’t mix ball gowns with jeans
  • Let one person be the anchor — pick the outfit you love most, then coordinate everyone else around it

Best Color Palettes for Family Photos

Classic Neutrals

Cream, beige, tan, and white — timeless and elegant. Works beautifully on the beach, in a studio, or in a field. Add texture with knits, linen, or lace to keep it from looking flat. This palette never goes out of style.

Blue and White

Fresh, clean, and universally flattering. Navy, chambray, light blue, and white in various combinations always photograph well. This is probably the most popular family photo color scheme for a reason. Browse our tops collection for blue options.

Earth Tones

Rust, olive, mustard, burgundy, and cream — perfect for fall family photos. These warm colors look incredible in golden hour light and complement autumn backdrops like changing leaves and pumpkin patches.

Jewel Tones

Emerald, sapphire, ruby, and gold — rich and luxurious. These colors pop against both indoor and outdoor settings and look stunning in holiday photos. Perfect for dressing up without going too formal.

Pastels

Soft pink, lavender, mint, and baby blue — dreamy and feminine. Beautiful for spring photos, Easter sessions, and mommy and me dress moments. Light colors photograph best in soft, natural light.

Family Photo Outfits by Season

Spring Photos

Light layers, floral prints, and pastel colors define spring family photos. Think:

  • Mom and daughter in matching floral dresses
  • Dad and son in coordinating button-downs with chinos
  • The whole family in soft pastels
  • Light cardigans or jackets for layering

Summer Photos

Keep it light and breathable. White and blue palettes look fresh and beachy. Consider:

  • Matching swimsuits for beach photos
  • Linen or cotton outfits that flow in the breeze
  • Sundresses for mom and daughter, casual shirts for dad and son
  • Bare feet on the beach — the most natural summer look

Fall Photos

The most popular season for family photos. Rich colors and cozy textures shine:

  • Matching sweaters or coordinating knits
  • Plaid and flannel accents
  • Boots, scarves, and layered looks
  • Earth tone color palettes against autumn backdrops

Winter / Holiday Photos

Holiday photos are the ultimate matching opportunity:

  • Matching Christmas pajamas in front of the tree
  • Coordinating dressy outfits for holiday cards
  • Matching holiday sweaters
  • Red, green, gold, or winter white color schemes

What to Avoid in Family Photos

A few things that don’t photograph well:

  • Large logos or text — distracts from faces
  • Neon colors — can cast unflattering reflections on skin
  • All black — loses detail and can look heavy
  • Busy patterns that clash — if everyone wears a different pattern, it’s visual chaos
  • Brand new shoes — kids walking weird in stiff new shoes kills candid shots
  • Anything uncomfortable — if someone is pulling at their clothes, it shows in photos

Pro Tips from Family Photographers

  1. Plan around your delivery estimate — check the estimate for your destination and allow time to try on outfits before the photo session
  2. Lay all outfits out together — see how they look as a group before the shoot
  3. Bring a backup outfit — especially for little ones (spills happen)
  4. Iron or steam everything — wrinkles show up in photos
  5. Accessorize — hats, bows, and headbands add personality
  6. Comfort first — a happy, comfortable family always photographs better than an uncomfortable one in perfect outfits

Ready-Made Matching Family Outfits

Don’t want to coordinate everything yourself? That’s exactly what matching family outfits are for. Our collections are designed to take the guesswork out of family dressing:

  • Mommy and Me matching outfits — dresses, tops, and sets
  • Daddy and Me outfits — coordinating tees and shorts
  • Family matching sets — coordinated looks for the whole crew
  • Full family matching — everyone matches, no stress

The best family photos capture who you are — together. And matching outfits are the easiest way to make sure everyone looks and feels like a team. Start browsing, pick your palette, and get ready to create some memories.

Planlegger du en familiefotografering? Det viktigste spørsmålet alle familier stiller er: hva skal vi alle ha på oss? Svaret er enklere enn du tror — matchende antrekk. Koordinerte familieantrekk fotograferes vakkert, forteller en visuell historie og fjerner stresset med antrekksplanlegging.

Enten du booker en profesjonell fotograf, tar julekortbilder eller bare vil ha flotte familiebilder til sosiale medier, har denne guiden deg dekket med matchende antrekksideer for alle årstider og settinger.

Den gyldne regel: Koordiner, ikke kopier

De beste familiebildene har koordinerte antrekk — ikke nødvendigvis identiske. Du vil at alle skal se ut som de hører sammen uten å se ut som uniformer. Slik gjør du det:

  • Velg en fargepalett — velg 2-3 farger som utfyller hverandre
  • Bland mønstre og ensfarget — hvis mamma har en mønstret kjole, kan pappa ha en ensfarget skjorte i matchende farge
  • Hold samme formelle nivå — ikke bland ballkjoler med jeans
  • La én person være ankeret — velg antrekket du liker best, og koordiner resten rundt det

Beste fargepaletter for familiebilder

Klassiske nøytrale farger

Krem, beige, tan og hvitt — tidløst og elegant. Fungerer vakkert på stranden, i studio eller på en eng. Legg til tekstur med strikk, lin eller blonder for å unngå at det ser flatt ut. Denne paletten går aldri av moten.

Blått og hvitt

Friskt, rent og universelt flatterende. Marineblå, chambray, lyseblått og hvitt i ulike kombinasjoner fotograferes alltid godt. Dette er sannsynligvis den mest populære fargepaletten for familiebilder av en grunn. Se gjennom vår toppkolleksjon for blå alternativer.

Jordfarger

Rust, olivengrønn, sennep, burgunder og krem — perfekt for høstfamiliebilder. Disse varme fargene ser utrolige ut i gyllent sollys og passer til høstbakgrunner som skiftende blader og gresskaråkre.

Juveltoner

Smaragd, safir, rubin og gull — rikt og luksuriøst. Disse fargene skiller seg ut både innendørs og utendørs og ser fantastiske ut på julebilder. Perfekt for å pynte seg uten å bli for formell.

Pasteller

Myk rosa, lavendel, mynte og babyblå — drømmende og feminint. Vakkert til vårbilder, påskesesjoner og mamma og meg-kjole-øyeblikk. Lyse farger fotograferes best i mykt, naturlig lys.

Familiebildeantrekk etter årstid

Vårbilder

Lette lag, blomsterprint og pastellfarger definerer vårfamiliebilder. Tenk:

  • Mamma og datter i matchende blomstrete kjoler
  • Pappa og sønn i koordinerte skjorter med chinos
  • Hele familien i myke pasteller
  • Lette cardigans eller jakker for lag-på-lag

Sommerbilder

Hold det lett og luftig. Hvite og blå paletter ser friske og strandaktige ut. Vurder:

  • Matchende badetøy til strandbilder
  • Linne- eller bomullsantrekk som flagrer i vinden
  • Sommerskjoler til mamma og datter, casual skjorter til pappa og sønn
  • Barfot på stranden — det mest naturlige sommerutseendet

Høstbilder

Den mest populære årstiden for familiebilder. Rike farger og koselige teksturer skinner:

  • Matchende gensere eller koordinerte strikkeplagg
  • Rutete og flanell-detaljer
  • Støvler, skjerf og lag-på-lag antrekk
  • Jordfargede paletter mot høstlige bakgrunner

Vinter- / julebilder

Julebilder er den ultimate muligheten for matching:

  • Matchende julepyjamas foran juletreet
  • Koordinerte pyntede antrekk til julekort
  • Matchende julegenser
  • Røde, grønne, gull- eller vinterhvite fargepaletter

Hva du bør unngå i familiebilder

Noen ting som ikke fotograferes godt:

  • Store logoer eller tekst — distraherer fra ansiktene
  • Neonfarger — kan gi uheldige refleksjoner på huden
  • Hel-svart — mister detaljer og kan se tungt ut
  • Travle mønstre som kolliderer — hvis alle har forskjellige mønstre, blir det visuelt kaos
  • Helt nye sko — barn som går rart i stive nye sko ødelegger spontane bilder
  • Alt som er ukomfortabelt — hvis noen drar i klærne sine, vises det på bildene

Profftips fra familie-fotografer

  1. Planlegg antrekk 2 uker i forveien — unngå stress dagen før
  2. Legg alle antrekkene ut sammen — se hvordan de ser ut som gruppe før fotograferingen
  3. Ta med et reserveantrekk — spesielt for de minste (søl skjer)
  4. Stryk eller damp alt — rynker vises på bilder
  5. Accessorize — hatter, sløyfer og hårbånd gir personlighet
  6. Komfort først — en glad, komfortabel familie fotograferes alltid bedre enn en ukomfortabel i perfekte antrekk

Ferdiglagde matchende familieantrekk

Vil du ikke koordinere alt selv? Det er akkurat det matchende familieantrekk er til for. Våre kolleksjoner er designet for å fjerne gjettingen ved familieantrekk:

  • Mamma og meg matchende antrekk — kjoler, topper og sett
  • Pappa og meg-antrekk — koordinerte t-skjorter og shorts
  • Familie-matching sett — koordinerte antrekk for hele gjengen
  • Full familie-matching — alle matcher, ingen stress

De beste familiebildene fanger hvem dere er — sammen. Og matchende antrekk er den enkleste måten å sørge for at alle ser ut og føler seg som et lag. Begynn å bla, velg fargepaletten din, og gjør deg klar til å skape minner.

Skriv én linje for hver person på bildet: plagget de skal ha på, valgt størrelse, antallet du trenger, og klær de allerede har som passer til. Begynn med ett mønster eller én farge du liker, og bygg videre derfra.

  1. Velg plaggene. Bestem hvem som trenger en kjole, en skjorte eller et annet plagg. Kontroller hva hvert produktvalg inkluderer før du legger det i handlekurven.

  3. Tell plaggene. For kjoler som selges separat, legger du til en størrelse til mor og en størrelse til datter som separate valg. Gå gjennom hver linje og samlet pris i handlekurven.

Planning a family photo session? The number one question every family faces is: what do we all wear? The answer is simpler than you think — matching outfits. Coordinated family looks photograph beautifully, tell a visual story, and take the stress out of outfit planning.

Whether you’re booking a professional photographer, taking holiday card photos, or just want great family pictures for social media, this guide has you covered with matching outfit ideas for every season and setting.

Plan each person's outfit before you order

Make one line for each person in your photo: the piece they will wear, their selected size, the quantity you need, and anything they already own that coordinates. Start with one print or color you love, then build around it.

  1. Choose the pieces. Decide who needs a dress, a shirt, or another item. Check what each product selection includes before adding it to your bag.
  2. Check every person's size. Open the size chart on that exact product page. Compare the measurements and units shown; use age labels as a starting point. Different styles can use different size ranges.
  3. Count the items. For dresses sold separately, add a mother size and a daughter size as separate selections. Review each line and the combined price in your bag.
  4. Check timing for your destination. Read the current delivery estimate and shipping information before ordering, and allow time to try everything on. If your photo date is close, use an outfit you already have.
  5. Finish the look. Lay the outfits together with shoes and any layers you own. Check that everyone can sit, walk, and move comfortably.

Two mother-daughter dress looks to build around

  • Vibrant Rainbow Mommy and Me Maxi Dresses: start with the rainbow stripes, then use one of those colors for other family members' clothes.
  • Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses: build around the pastel floral print and coordinate with pieces you already own.

For both looks, each mother or daughter dress is sold separately. Check the current product page for selectable sizes, prices, size guidance, and delivery estimates. For more options, browse mommy and me dresses.

The Golden Rule: Coordinate, Don’t Clone

The best family photos feature coordinated outfits — not necessarily identical ones. You want everyone to look like they belong together without looking like a uniform. Here’s how:

  • Pick a color palette — choose 2-3 colors that complement each other
  • Mix patterns and solids — if mom wears a patterned dress, dad can wear a solid shirt in a matching color
  • Keep the same level of formality — don’t mix ball gowns with jeans
  • Let one person be the anchor — pick the outfit you love most, then coordinate everyone else around it

Best Color Palettes for Family Photos

Classic Neutrals

Cream, beige, tan, and white — timeless and elegant. Works beautifully on the beach, in a studio, or in a field. Add texture with knits, linen, or lace to keep it from looking flat. This palette never goes out of style.

Blue and White

Fresh, clean, and universally flattering. Navy, chambray, light blue, and white in various combinations always photograph well. This is probably the most popular family photo color scheme for a reason. Browse our tops collection for blue options.

Earth Tones

Rust, olive, mustard, burgundy, and cream — perfect for fall family photos. These warm colors look incredible in golden hour light and complement autumn backdrops like changing leaves and pumpkin patches.

Jewel Tones

Emerald, sapphire, ruby, and gold — rich and luxurious. These colors pop against both indoor and outdoor settings and look stunning in holiday photos. Perfect for dressing up without going too formal.

Pastels

Soft pink, lavender, mint, and baby blue — dreamy and feminine. Beautiful for spring photos, Easter sessions, and mommy and me dress moments. Light colors photograph best in soft, natural light.

Family Photo Outfits by Season

Spring Photos

Light layers, floral prints, and pastel colors define spring family photos. Think:

  • Mom and daughter in matching floral dresses
  • Dad and son in coordinating button-downs with chinos
  • The whole family in soft pastels
  • Light cardigans or jackets for layering

Summer Photos

Keep it light and breathable. White and blue palettes look fresh and beachy. Consider:

  • Matching swimsuits for beach photos
  • Linen or cotton outfits that flow in the breeze
  • Sundresses for mom and daughter, casual shirts for dad and son
  • Bare feet on the beach — the most natural summer look

Fall Photos

The most popular season for family photos. Rich colors and cozy textures shine:

  • Matching sweaters or coordinating knits
  • Plaid and flannel accents
  • Boots, scarves, and layered looks
  • Earth tone color palettes against autumn backdrops

Winter / Holiday Photos

Holiday photos are the ultimate matching opportunity:

  • Matching Christmas pajamas in front of the tree
  • Coordinating dressy outfits for holiday cards
  • Matching holiday sweaters
  • Red, green, gold, or winter white color schemes

What to Avoid in Family Photos

A few things that don’t photograph well:

  • Large logos or text — distracts from faces
  • Neon colors — can cast unflattering reflections on skin
  • All black — loses detail and can look heavy
  • Busy patterns that clash — if everyone wears a different pattern, it’s visual chaos
  • Brand new shoes — kids walking weird in stiff new shoes kills candid shots
  • Anything uncomfortable — if someone is pulling at their clothes, it shows in photos

Pro Tips from Family Photographers

  1. Plan around your delivery estimate — check the estimate for your destination and allow time to try on outfits before the photo session
  2. Lay all outfits out together — see how they look as a group before the shoot
  3. Bring a backup outfit — especially for little ones (spills happen)
  4. Iron or steam everything — wrinkles show up in photos
  5. Accessorize — hats, bows, and headbands add personality
  6. Comfort first — a happy, comfortable family always photographs better than an uncomfortable one in perfect outfits

Ready-Made Matching Family Outfits

Don’t want to coordinate everything yourself? That’s exactly what matching family outfits are for. Our collections are designed to take the guesswork out of family dressing:

  • Mommy and Me matching outfits — dresses, tops, and sets
  • Daddy and Me outfits — coordinating tees and shorts
  • Family matching sets — coordinated looks for the whole crew
  • Full family matching — everyone matches, no stress

The best family photos capture who you are — together. And matching outfits are the easiest way to make sure everyone looks and feels like a team. Start browsing, pick your palette, and get ready to create some memories.

Planejando uma sessão de fotos em família? A pergunta número um que toda família enfrenta é: o que todos nós vamos vestir? A resposta é mais simples do que você pensa — roupas combinando. Looks coordenados para família fotografam lindamente, contam uma história visual e tiram o estresse do planejamento das roupas.

Seja contratando um fotógrafo profissional, tirando fotos para cartão de festas ou apenas querendo ótimas fotos de família para redes sociais, este guia tem ideias de roupas combinando para todas as estações e ambientes.

A Regra de Ouro: Coordene, Não Clone

As melhores fotos de família apresentam roupas coordenadas — não necessariamente idênticas. Você quer que todos pareçam pertencer ao mesmo grupo sem parecerem uniformizados. Veja como:

  • Escolha uma paleta de cores — selecione 2-3 cores que se complementem
  • Combine estampas e peças lisas — se a mãe usar um vestido estampado, o pai pode usar uma camisa lisa na mesma cor
  • Mantenha o mesmo nível de formalidade — não misture vestidos de festa com jeans
  • Deixe uma pessoa ser o ponto central — escolha a roupa que você mais gosta e coordene o resto da família em torno dela

Melhores Paletas de Cores para Fotos de Família

Neutros Clássicos

Creme, bege, caramelo e branco — atemporal e elegante. Funciona lindamente na praia, em estúdio ou no campo. Adicione textura com tricôs, linho ou renda para evitar que pareça sem vida. Essa paleta nunca sai de moda.

Azul e Branco

Fresco, limpo e universalmente favorecedor. Marinho, chambray, azul claro e branco em várias combinações sempre fotografam bem. Provavelmente é o esquema de cores para fotos de família mais popular por um motivo. Confira nossa coleção de blusas para opções em azul.

Tons Terrosos

Ferrugem, oliva, mostarda, bordô e creme — perfeitos para fotos de família no outono. Essas cores quentes ficam incríveis na luz do pôr do sol e complementam cenários de outono como folhas mudando de cor e plantações de abóboras.

Tons Joia

Esmeralda, safira, rubi e dourado — ricos e luxuosos. Essas cores se destacam tanto em ambientes internos quanto externos e ficam deslumbrantes em fotos de festas. Perfeito para se arrumar sem ficar muito formal.

Pastéis

Rosa suave, lavanda, menta e azul bebê — sonhador e feminino. Lindo para fotos de primavera, sessões de Páscoa e momentos de vestidos mãe e filha. Cores claras fotografam melhor com luz natural suave.

Roupas para Fotos de Família por Estação

Fotos de Primavera

Camadas leves, estampas florais e cores pastéis definem fotos de família na primavera. Pense em:

  • Mãe e filha com vestidos florais combinando
  • Pai e filho com camisas sociais coordenadas e calças chino
  • A família toda em tons pastéis suaves
  • Cardigans ou jaquetas leves para sobreposição

Fotos de Verão

Mantenha leve e respirável. Paletas em branco e azul parecem frescas e praianas. Considere:

  • Maiôs combinando para fotos na praia
  • Roupas de linho ou algodão que esvoaçam na brisa
  • Vestidos para mãe e filha, camisas casuais para pai e filho
  • Pés descalços na praia — o look mais natural do verão

Fotos de outono

A estação mais popular para fotos de família. Cores ricas e texturas aconchegantes brilham:

  • Suéteres combinando ou malhas coordenadas
  • Detalhes em xadrez e flanela
  • Botas, cachecóis e looks em camadas
  • Paletas de tons terrosos com fundos de outono

Fotos de inverno / feriado

Fotos de feriado são a oportunidade perfeita para combinar:

  • Pijamas de Natal combinando na frente da árvore
  • Roupas formais coordenadas para cartões de feriado
  • Suéteres combinando para feriados
  • Esquemas de cores vermelho, verde, dourado ou branco inverno

O que evitar nas fotos de família

Algumas coisas que não ficam bem nas fotos:

  • Logos ou textos grandes — distraem do rosto
  • Cores neon — podem refletir de forma desfavorável na pele
  • Todo preto — perde detalhes e pode parecer pesado
  • Estampas muito carregadas que não combinam — se cada um usar uma estampa diferente, vira caos visual
  • Calçados novos — crianças andando estranho com sapatos rígidos estragam fotos espontâneas
  • Qualquer coisa desconfortável — se alguém ficar mexendo na roupa, isso aparece nas fotos

Dicas de fotógrafos de família

  1. Planeje as roupas com 2 semanas de antecedência — não deixe para a última hora
  2. Separe todas as roupas juntas — veja como ficam em grupo antes da sessão
  3. Leve uma roupa reserva — especialmente para os pequenos (acidentes acontecem)
  4. Passe a ferro ou use vapor em tudo — rugas aparecem nas fotos
  5. Acessórios — chapéus, laços e faixas de cabelo adicionam personalidade
  6. Conforto em primeiro lugar — uma família feliz e confortável sempre fotografa melhor do que uma desconfortável com roupas perfeitas

Roupas combinando prontas para família

Não quer coordenar tudo sozinho? É exatamente para isso que servem as roupas combinando para família. Nossas coleções são feitas para tirar a dúvida na hora de vestir a família:

  • Roupas combinando Mamãe e Eu — vestidos, blusas e conjuntos
  • Roupas Pai e Eu — camisetas e shorts coordenados
  • Conjuntos combinando para família — looks coordenados para toda a turma
  • Combinação completa para toda a família — todo mundo combinando, sem estresse

As melhores fotos de família capturam quem vocês são — juntos. E roupas combinando são a maneira mais fácil de garantir que todos pareçam e se sintam como um time. Comece a navegar, escolha sua paleta e prepare-se para criar memórias.

Plănuiești o sesiune foto de familie? Întrebarea numărul unu pe care o are orice familie este: ce purtăm cu toții? Răspunsul este mai simplu decât crezi — ținută asortată. Look-urile coordonate de familie se fotografiază frumos, spun o poveste vizuală și elimină stresul planificării ținutelor.

Fie că rezervi un fotograf profesionist, faci fotografii pentru felicitări de sărbători sau vrei pur și simplu poze grozave de familie pentru social media, acest ghid te ajută cu idei de ținute asortate pentru fiecare sezon și decor.

Regula de aur: coordonează, nu clona

Cele mai bune fotografii de familie prezintă ținute coordonate — nu neapărat identice. Vrei ca toată lumea să pară că aparține împreună, fără să arate ca o uniformă. Iată cum:

  • Alege o paletă de culori — selectează 2-3 culori care se completează reciproc
  • Combină imprimeuri și culori uni — dacă mama poartă o rochie cu imprimeu, tatăl poate purta o cămașă uni într-o culoare asortată
  • Păstrează același nivel de formalitate — nu combina rochii de bal cu blugi
  • Lasă o persoană să fie ancora — alege ținuta care îți place cel mai mult, apoi coordonează-i pe ceilalți în jurul ei

Cele mai bune palete de culori pentru fotografii de familie

Neutre clasice

Crem, bej, nisip și alb — atemporale și elegante. Funcționează minunat pe plajă, în studio sau într-un câmp. Adaugă textură cu tricotaje, in sau dantelă pentru a evita un aspect plat. Această paletă nu se demodează niciodată.

Albastru și alb

Proaspete, curate și universal avantajoase. Bleumarin, chambray, albastru deschis și alb în diverse combinații se fotografiază întotdeauna bine. Probabil acesta este cel mai popular schemă de culori pentru fotografii de familie, și pe bună dreptate. Răsfoiește colecția noastră de topuri pentru opțiuni albastre.

Tonuri pământii

Rugină, măsliniu, muștar, burgund și crem — perfecte pentru fotografiile de familie de toamnă. Aceste culori calde arată incredibil în lumina de aur și completează fundalurile de toamnă, cum ar fi frunzele care se schimbă și câmpurile cu dovleci.

Tonuri de bijuterii

Smarald, safir, rubin și auriu — bogate și luxoase. Aceste culori ies în evidență atât în decoruri interioare, cât și exterioare și arată uimitor în fotografiile de sărbători. Perfecte pentru a te îmbrăca elegant fără a fi prea formal.

Pasteluri

Roz pal, lavandă, mentă și albastru deschis — visător și feminin. Minunate pentru fotografii de primăvară, sesiuni de Paște și momente mamă și copil. Culorile deschise se fotografiază cel mai bine în lumină naturală, blândă.

Ținute pentru fotografii de familie după sezon

Fotografii de primăvară

Straturi ușoare, imprimeuri florale și culori pastel definesc fotografiile de familie de primăvară. Gândește-te la:

  • Mama și fiica în rochii florale asortate
  • Tatăl și fiul în cămăși cu nasturi asortate și pantaloni chino
  • Toată familia în pasteluri moi
  • Cardigane sau jachete ușoare pentru suprapunere

Fotografii de vară

Păstrează ținutele ușoare și respirabile. Paletele de alb și albastru arată proaspăt și de vară. Ia în considerare:

  • Costume de baie asortate pentru fotografiile de pe plajă
  • Ținute din in sau bumbac care flutură în adiere
  • Rochii vaporoase pentru mamă și fiică, cămăși casual pentru tată și fiu
  • Picioare goale pe plajă — cel mai natural look de vară

Fotografii de toamnă

Cea mai populară perioadă pentru fotografii de familie. Culori bogate și texturi confortabile strălucesc:

  • Pulovere asortate sau tricotaje coordonate
  • Accente în carouri și flanel
  • Cizme, eșarfe și look-uri stratificate
  • Palete de culori în tonuri pământii pe fundaluri de toamnă

Fotografii de iarnă / sărbători

Fotografiile de sărbători sunt ocazia perfectă pentru ținute asortate:

  • Pijamale de Crăciun asortate în fața bradului
  • Ținute elegante coordonate pentru felicitările de sărbători
  • Pulovere de sărbători asortate
  • Scheme de culori roșu, verde, auriu sau alb de iarnă

Ce să eviți în fotografiile de familie

Câteva lucruri care nu ies bine în fotografii:

  • Logo-uri mari sau texte — distrag atenția de la fețe
  • Culori neon — pot reflecta nuanțe nefavorabile pe piele
  • Totul negru — pierde detalii și poate părea greu
  • Modele încărcate care se bat cap în cap — dacă toată lumea poartă un model diferit, rezultă un haos vizual
  • Încălțăminte nouă-nouță — copiii care merg ciudat în pantofi rigizi strică pozele naturale
  • Orice incomoditate — dacă cineva își trage hainele, se vede în poze

Sfaturi Profesionale de la Fotografii de Familie

  1. Planificați ținutele cu 2 săptămâni înainte — să nu vă grăbiți în ultima zi
  2. Așezați toate ținutele împreună — vedeți cum arată ca grup înainte de ședință
  3. Adăugați o ținută de rezervă — mai ales pentru cei mici (se întâmplă accidente)
  4. Călcați sau aburiți totul — cutele se văd în poze
  5. Accesorizează — pălării, funde și bentițe adaugă personalitate
  6. Confortul pe primul loc — o familie fericită și confortabilă se fotografiază întotdeauna mai bine decât una incomodă, chiar dacă poartă ținute perfecte

Nu vrei să coordonezi totul singur? Exact pentru asta sunt ținutele asortate de familie. Colecțiile noastre sunt concepute să elimine bătaia de cap a alegerii hainelor pentru familie:

  • Ținute asortate Mamă și Eu — rochii, bluze și seturi
  • Ținute Tata și Eu — tricouri și pantaloni scurți coordonați
  • Seturi asortate pentru familie — look-uri coordonate pentru toată echipa
  • Ținute asortate pentru întreaga familie — toată lumea se potrivește, fără stres

Cele mai bune fotografii de familie surprind cine sunteți — împreună. Iar ținutele asortate sunt cea mai simplă metodă de a vă asigura că toată lumea arată și se simte ca o echipă. Începeți să răsfoiți, alegeți paleta și pregătiți-vă să creați amintiri.

Nu vrei să coordonezi totul singur? Exact pentru asta sunt ținutele asortate de familie. Colecțiile noastre sunt concepute să elimine bătaia de cap a alegerii hainelor pentru familie:

  • Ținute asortate Mamă și Eu — rochii, bluze și seturi
  • Ținute Tata și Eu — tricouri și pantaloni scurți coordonați
  • Seturi asortate pentru familie — look-uri coordonate pentru toată echipa
  • Ținute asortate pentru întreaga familie — toată lumea se potrivește, fără stres

Cele mai bune fotografii de familie surprind cine sunteți — împreună. Iar ținutele asortate sunt cea mai simplă metodă de a vă asigura că toată lumea arată și se simte ca o echipă. Începeți să răsfoiți, alegeți paleta și pregătiți-vă să creați amintiri.

Planning a family photo session? The number one question every family faces is: what do we all wear? The answer is simpler than you think — matching outfits. Coordinated family looks photograph beautifully, tell a visual story, and take the stress out of outfit planning.

Whether you’re booking a professional photographer, taking holiday card photos, or just want great family pictures for social media, this guide has you covered with matching outfit ideas for every season and setting.

Plan each person's outfit before you order

Make one line for each person in your photo: the piece they will wear, their selected size, the quantity you need, and anything they already own that coordinates. Start with one print or color you love, then build around it.

  1. Choose the pieces. Decide who needs a dress, a shirt, or another item. Check what each product selection includes before adding it to your bag.
  2. Check every person's size. Open the size chart on that exact product page. Compare the measurements and units shown; use age labels as a starting point. Different styles can use different size ranges.
  3. Count the items. For dresses sold separately, add a mother size and a daughter size as separate selections. Review each line and the combined price in your bag.
  4. Check timing for your destination. Read the current delivery estimate and shipping information before ordering, and allow time to try everything on. If your photo date is close, use an outfit you already have.
  5. Finish the look. Lay the outfits together with shoes and any layers you own. Check that everyone can sit, walk, and move comfortably.

Two mother-daughter dress looks to build around

  • Vibrant Rainbow Mommy and Me Maxi Dresses: start with the rainbow stripes, then use one of those colors for other family members' clothes.
  • Pastel Bloom Mommy and Me Dresses: build around the pastel floral print and coordinate with pieces you already own.

For both looks, each mother or daughter dress is sold separately. Check the current product page for selectable sizes, prices, size guidance, and delivery estimates. For more options, browse mommy and me dresses.

The Golden Rule: Coordinate, Don’t Clone

The best family photos feature coordinated outfits — not necessarily identical ones. You want everyone to look like they belong together without looking like a uniform. Here’s how:

  • Pick a color palette — choose 2-3 colors that complement each other
  • Mix patterns and solids — if mom wears a patterned dress, dad can wear a solid shirt in a matching color
  • Keep the same level of formality — don’t mix ball gowns with jeans
  • Let one person be the anchor — pick the outfit you love most, then coordinate everyone else around it

Best Color Palettes for Family Photos

Classic Neutrals

Cream, beige, tan, and white — timeless and elegant. Works beautifully on the beach, in a studio, or in a field. Add texture with knits, linen, or lace to keep it from looking flat. This palette never goes out of style.

Blue and White

Fresh, clean, and universally flattering. Navy, chambray, light blue, and white in various combinations always photograph well. This is probably the most popular family photo color scheme for a reason. Browse our tops collection for blue options.

Earth Tones

Rust, olive, mustard, burgundy, and cream — perfect for fall family photos. These warm colors look incredible in golden hour light and complement autumn backdrops like changing leaves and pumpkin patches.

Jewel Tones

Emerald, sapphire, ruby, and gold — rich and luxurious. These colors pop against both indoor and outdoor settings and look stunning in holiday photos. Perfect for dressing up without going too formal.

Pastels

Soft pink, lavender, mint, and baby blue — dreamy and feminine. Beautiful for spring photos, Easter sessions, and mommy and me dress moments. Light colors photograph best in soft, natural light.

Family Photo Outfits by Season

Spring Photos

Light layers, floral prints, and pastel colors define spring family photos. Think:

  • Mom and daughter in matching floral dresses
  • Dad and son in coordinating button-downs with chinos
  • The whole family in soft pastels
  • Light cardigans or jackets for layering

Summer Photos

Keep it light and breathable. White and blue palettes look fresh and beachy. Consider:

  • Matching swimsuits for beach photos
  • Linen or cotton outfits that flow in the breeze
  • Sundresses for mom and daughter, casual shirts for dad and son
  • Bare feet on the beach — the most natural summer look

Fall Photos

The most popular season for family photos. Rich colors and cozy textures shine:

  • Matching sweaters or coordinating knits
  • Plaid and flannel accents
  • Boots, scarves, and layered looks
  • Earth tone color palettes against autumn backdrops

Winter / Holiday Photos

Holiday photos are the ultimate matching opportunity:

  • Matching Christmas pajamas in front of the tree
  • Coordinating dressy outfits for holiday cards
  • Matching holiday sweaters
  • Red, green, gold, or winter white color schemes

What to Avoid in Family Photos

A few things that don’t photograph well:

  • Large logos or text — distracts from faces
  • Neon colors — can cast unflattering reflections on skin
  • All black — loses detail and can look heavy
  • Busy patterns that clash — if everyone wears a different pattern, it’s visual chaos
  • Brand new shoes — kids walking weird in stiff new shoes kills candid shots
  • Anything uncomfortable — if someone is pulling at their clothes, it shows in photos

Pro Tips from Family Photographers

  1. Plan around your delivery estimate — check the estimate for your destination and allow time to try on outfits before the photo session
  2. Lay all outfits out together — see how they look as a group before the shoot
  3. Bring a backup outfit — especially for little ones (spills happen)
  4. Iron or steam everything — wrinkles show up in photos
  5. Accessorize — hats, bows, and headbands add personality
  6. Comfort first — a happy, comfortable family always photographs better than an uncomfortable one in perfect outfits

Ready-Made Matching Family Outfits

Don’t want to coordinate everything yourself? That’s exactly what matching family outfits are for. Our collections are designed to take the guesswork out of family dressing:

  • Mommy and Me matching outfits — dresses, tops, and sets
  • Daddy and Me outfits — coordinating tees and shorts
  • Family matching sets — coordinated looks for the whole crew
  • Full family matching — everyone matches, no stress

The best family photos capture who you are — together. And matching outfits are the easiest way to make sure everyone looks and feels like a team. Start browsing, pick your palette, and get ready to create some memories.
